name: Creator, Audio & Media Products

designIntent.primaryGoal: Make discovery, playback and library management immediate and understandable.
designIntent.visualThesis: Media content supplies the emotional identity; controls remain precise and persistent.

visualDirection.density: medium; dense libraries need compact, scannable rows
visualDirection.surfaces: content artwork may dominate; player and navigation remain stable
visualDirection.colorIntent: artwork-led accent can be used carefully, but control labels and playback states need reliable contrast
visualDirection.typography: metadata hierarchy separates title, creator, album/show and duration
visualDirection.motion: playback transitions and progress feedback; avoid motion that hides controls

layout.pattern: navigation + discovery/library surface + persistent player or media controls
layout.spacing: balanced cards for discovery and compact rows for large libraries
layout.responsive: player controls adapt without hiding primary actions or current item

accessibility.keyboard: media controls, queue and navigation must be keyboard accessible
accessibility.focus: playback state is announced and visibly represented
accessibility.reducedMotion: animated artwork is optional and can be disabled

antiPatterns: artwork color used as the only status cue
player controls that shift layout constantly
notes: Do not assume a provider has playback rights or capabilities that its API does not document.

aiGuidance.primaryFlow: Discover content → inspect creator and metadata → play or preview → manage queue/library → resume listening or viewing.
prioritize: The current media item and its true playback state
Accessible play, pause, seek, volume and queue controls
Library identity, creator, source and availability
confirmOrMarkUnknown: Provider capabilities, rights and playback availability
Whether media is local, streamed, preview-only or unavailable
avoidByDefault: Fake playback progress or unavailable tracks shown as playable
Artwork making controls or metadata unreadable
acceptanceChecks: Playback controls have accessible names and stable focus
Playing, paused, buffering and unavailable states are distinct
The current item and queue persist where expected

compositionEscapes.when: Playback or viewing is the main reason to use the product.
compositionEscapes.composition: Give the current media and essential controls priority; keep queue, metadata and source information accessible without displacing playback.
contentRequirements: A real playable source or clearly labelled preview
Current item, creator and playback state

compositionEscapes.when: Users primarily search, organize, filter or resume a large personal media collection.
compositionEscapes.composition: Use a searchable library with compact media rows and selected-item context; expose the player as a persistent but non-obstructive surface.
contentRequirements: Actual library items and source metadata
Clear empty, unavailable and offline states
avoid: Oversized artwork card for every item
Assuming every catalog entry is playable

compositionEscapes.when: The experience centers on a scheduled stream, premiere, episode or live broadcast.
compositionEscapes.composition: Lead with event/player state, schedule and participation controls; place replay and related content after the live task.
contentRequirements: Actual live, offline or ended state
